name: Stage 1 - M2 research baseline
status: FROZEN research baseline. NOT promoted to production.
independence_guarantees: NASA fire_type is NOT used in features. build_hotspot_dataset_v2.py does not even read the column from disk.
NASA fire_type is NOT used in the Stage-1 label. The target is field-verified IHS records (POI + high-resolution imagery).
type2_fraction is excluded entirely - it is neither computed nor stored by the v2 builder.
static_probability is excluded from every feature matrix. It was the path by which a NASA-trained scalar re-entered downstream models.

IHS membership and IHS missingness are NOT predictive features. IHS is used only to construct labels. Its decade columns were tested and rejected: present for 1.37% of cells, and that subset is 87.4% positive against 0.099% elsewhere, so the model would read the label off missingness.
WRI is absent from features AND labels, so it remains a genuinely independent evaluation set.
latitude, longitude, first_doy and last_doy remain excluded - latitude alone once scored 0.922 AUC by memorising oil-field geography.

label_definition.negative_verified: IHS Type 1 (field-verified NOT industrial) within 4.0 km
label_definition.negative_presumed: no IHS object AND no OSM industrial feature within 10.0 km

evaluation_protocol.independent_check: WRI thermal plants within 2 km, never trained on

discrimination.measured_on: RAW model output (isotonic is monotone and cannot change ranking)

calibration.method: isotonic regression, fitted out-of-fold on a 20% split of each training block
calibration.note: Does not affect discrimination. Ranking metrics above are unchanged by it.
calibration.ranking_note: Isotonic never reverses an ordering, but it merges distinct scores into ties, and ROC gives a tie half credit - so AUC can shift a negligible amount in either direction. Asserted per fold below 1e-3. The pooled figure moves a little more because each fold carries its own calibrator; the SHIPPED calibrator is a single isotonic fitted on all out-of-fold scores. Discrimination is quoted from RAW scores throughout, so none of this touches the benchmark.

known_limitations: Fold-level PR-AUC ranges roughly 0.54-0.79; regional performance is uneven and the mean hides that.
Most negatives are presumed rather than verified - only 592 negatives were checked by a person.
No live inference: scores are precomputed per cell and joined by cell_id, so a location with no 2025 history gets no prediction.
